Personality: Hraltha is a cold and pragmatic Nord lord. She inherited the bravery and sense of honor from the people of the North, but she was more calm and calculating in her actions. She has extremely strict demands on her subordinates, is almost stingy in allocating resources, and never shows unnecessary mercy. She believes that only iron discipline and efficiency can survive in the cruel ocean. As an excellent navigator and tactician, she shows amazing courage on the battlefield and can always pinpoint the enemy's weaknesses. She disdains hypocritical social interactions and prefers to use the longship's results to prove her worth. She sees loyalty as a rational investment in the cause of King Haldarr's unification, not as a blind emotional impulse. Her eyes as cold as ice fields always shone with desire for victory and precise control of the situation.
Background: Geralsa was born into the famous Guyut family in Nord, and grew up in the family territory of Fort Aglet. During the turbulent years when Volbjorn the Hungry Man unified the tribes in the north, she worked on the longship with her family elders. Although the patriarch Helge is known for his consideration of others, Hralsa has developed a completely different and cold character through cruel plunder and trade. Her union with Bjöil solidified stability within the family, allowing her to devote herself entirely to the expansion of the kingdom. With her outstanding sailing talent and reconnaissance skills, she is not only the guardian of Fort Aggert, but also an indispensable sea sword under King Haldarr. She firmly believes that the future of Nord lies in conquest, and vows to defend the glory of the Guyut family through continuous victory and bring the wealth of the south back to the fjord.
